hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase text-white
hierarchy.h4: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-white/80

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: The Control Room Grid (Density, Data Correlation, Scanability)
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-1 px-1 py-1 bg-[#262626] border-collapse

panels.sidebar: col-span-12 md:col-span-3 bg-[#0A0A0A] p-6 h-full flex flex-col gap-8
panels.main_canvas: col-span-12 md:col-span-6 bg-[#0A0A0A] p-6 h-full flex flex-col justify-center items-center relative overflow-hidden
panels.right_panel: col-span-12 md:col-span-3 bg-[#0A0A0A] p-0 h-full flex flex-col

spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Strict 1px borders, no soft shadows. Everything feels like a structural blueprint.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary is bg-[#00FF66] text-black hover:bg-[#00CC52]. Secondary is border border-[#262626] text-white hover:bg-white/5.
components.sliders: Use Shadcn Slider. Customize track to be h-1 bg-[#262626], range bg-[#00FF66], thumb w-4 h-4 rounded-none bg-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A].
components.cards: Cardless. Use 1px border-[#262626] on wrapper divs. bg-[#141414] with p-6.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Customize list to border-b border-[#262626] rounded-none bg-transparent h-auto p-0. Triggers: rounded-none data-[state=active]:border-b-2 data-[state=active]:border-[#00FF66] data-[state=active]:text-[#00FF66].
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for technical density and crispness.

interactive_elements.hover_states: Hard background shifts (e.g., bg-[#141414] to bg-[#262626]). Text brightens to pure white.
interactive_elements.canvas_interaction: SVG bezier curves should highlight on hover with increased stroke width and a slight drop-shadow glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,102,0.5)] for green).

images.description: Abstract procedural 3D wireframe mesh resembling a complex Houdini node network for header or empty states.

feature_instructions_to_main_agent.svg_canvas: Build a responsive 4x4 grid. Render `<path>` elements for Bezier curves based on intersection logic (4-way, 3-way, 2-way). Apply stroke='#00FF66' for straight paths, stroke='#FF3B30' for turns. Chevrons (direction indicators) should be small triangle `<polygon>` or `<path>` elements placed at the midpoint of each curve using SVG `marker-mid` or explicit coordinate math. Include a grid background pattern using `<defs><pattern>`.
feature_instructions_to_main_agent.vex_code_generator: Create a robust state object that maps the 4 sliders to string templates of VEX code. Present this in a syntax-highlighted block (use Prism or simple pre/code with green text) with a 'Copy to Clipboard' button.
feature_instructions_to_main_agent.node_diagram: Build a visual flow of typical Houdini nodes for this setup (e.g., 'Grid' -> 'Intersection Gen' -> 'PolyPath' -> 'Sweep'). You can use simple div boxes connected by vertical lines or a library like React Flow if necessary, but simple styled divs with border and active states look more 'E1 Brutalist'.
feature_instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure EVERY slider, button, and tab trigger has a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='road-width-slider'`).
